crm_notes: Account background: mid-size legaltech vendor focused on compliance document discovery for financial services clients.
Scale: expected corpus for initial rollout ~120M documents (email, contracts, filings), estimated embedding index ~6-8TB compressed.
Primary ask: RAG search with embeddings + learned reranker. First-pass ANN retrieval then model-based rerank to improve precision on legal clauses.
Latency targets: 95th pct end-to-end rerank <800ms for single-file search; first-pass ANN <300ms at p95 for top-200 retrieval. Throughput target 150 qps during business hours.
Cost sensitivity: target incremental cost per user query <$0.08 after batching/caching. Interested in Redwood Optimize recommendations for batching + quantization to hit targets.

Deployment: must run in customer VPC or on-prem for regulated customers; US-only data residency requirement for current pilot (clients: major banks). Audit logging + 7-year retention for activity logs is a hard requirement.
Security: SSO (SAML) in place, requires SOC2 Type II + ISO27001 evidence. KMS integration for key management. Need demonstration of immutable audit logs and retention controls.

POC notes: running initial embedding scale test (Feb 2026) using Redwood hosted vector vs self-managed Faiss. Embedding model: in-house tuned 1024-d model; reranker prototype uses quantized 7B model for candidate re-scoring.

POC results (03-08-2026): Redwood-managed vector index returned top-200 recall parity with Faiss at 64% but latency 22% lower when using automatic sharding. Rerank quality uplift ~18% measured on labeling set (precision@5). Cost projections show 35% savings using KV caching + batching recommendations.
Quote from CTO: "Can't send full corpora to external buckets — VPC or on-prem only. Audit trails must be searchable and exportable for legal holds."
Legal/compliance: retention policy concerns flagged by GC — needs exportable audit logs, retention enforcement, and deletion certification for specific litigations.
Operations notes: network team requested detailed peering matrix and example security group rules; they require a dry-run for VPC peering before any data ingress.

Risks: indexing cost at projected production scale could exceed budget if we can't make reranker sufficiently cheap per query; fallback strategy being discussed (hybrid retrieval-only for low-value queries).
Next technical milestone: schedule VPC peering test and a 24-hour high-throughput load run to validate p95 latencies and autoscaling behavior (target week of 2026-03-17).
Sales/contract: procurement asked for 3-year committed capacity pricing for Dedicated + Private option; finance wants unit economics for 250 qps sustained load.
Follow-ups: send redacted embedding scale report, security artifact bundle, and example VPC peering playbook (links above).
